### Changelog for self-improving-agent v4.0.3

## Added
- Cause-aware maintenance for saved knowledge, including one-off and unpromoted learnings.
- Four decay types determine how to revalidate: reality, decision, dependency, and relevance.
- Qualitative review rates—fast, medium, slow, and durable—determine when to check. Relevant changes override cadence.
- Lightweight maintenance metadata records each claim’s scope, authority, review triggers, and actual dated evidence.
